subject: I received a damaged book. Please guide me on how to request a replacement.
message: I received a damaged book. Please guide me on how to request a replacement.
adminResponse:
Dear Author,

I am very sorry to hear that your book arrived damaged. Under our policy, verified printing defects qualify for a free reprint.

To help us assist you with requesting a replacement, please reply with clear photos showing the damage or defect along with your order details. Once we can verify the issue, we will work with our production team to arrange a reprint for you.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Best regards,
BookLeaf Support Team
